retrieval_skill.name: layered_regime_retrieval
retrieval_skill.description: Separate observation failures from genuine process changes, identify when measurements become reliable, and retrieve evidence for the latest stable trend, its underlying mechanism, and any bounded terminal state.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When forecasting a time series containing a documented anomaly followed by a reliable recent regime and a physically constrained endpoint.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search sequentially for the anomaly's scope and affected layer, the point at which observations regain reliability, the trend supported by post-recovery data, evidence that the mechanism continues into the forecast horizon, and evidence for behavior after reaching a physical boundary.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept a claim only when its source clearly distinguishes corrupted observations from the latent process, supports the active regime using reliable in-window evidence, and explicitly justifies both reaching and remaining at any asserted boundary; preserve exact-quote, provenance, and temporal-window requirements.
